visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short brown hair and round glasses, wearing a white collared shirt and a gold watch, sits in a professional office setting. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions, pointing her finger for emphasis. The background shows a lamp, framed certificates, and a medical coat on a chair under bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of the doctor's face as she continues her explanation, using wide hand gestures. Large red and white text boxes appear in the center of the frame, partially obscuring her torso. The lighting remains consistent and focused on her features. (3) An extreme close-up shot shows a medical procedure where a laser device is being applied to a patient's skin near the temple, creating small white circular patterns. A metal shield protects the patient's eye. The environment is clinical and brightly lit. (4) The video cuts back to the doctor in her office, who continues speaking and miming actions like putting on a mask. A graphic of a light blue surgical mask is superimposed over her face temporarily. She maintains high eye contact with the viewer. (5) Another close-up shows a patient's cheek with red acne scars being treated with a translucent hydrocolloid dressing. A hand is seen carefully applying and then peeling back the dressing to reveal the skin underneath. The shot is tightly framed on the skin texture. (6) The final phase features a static end screen with a white background. It displays the clinic's logo, social media handle, phone number, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text. The layout is clean and professional.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, moderate-tempo electronic pop track begins as the primary background music. A high-pitched, energetic female voice speaks in Mandarin with a clear, assertive, and professional tone. The speech rate is fast, with high pitch variability and occasional emphasis on specific words to convey authority. (2) A sharp digital 'pop' sound effect triggers as a red text graphic appears on screen. The female voice continues at a high arousal level, her tone becoming slightly teasing yet firm when describing how she scolds patients who don't follow instructions. (3) The background music maintains a steady 4/4 beat with synthesized bass. The speaker transitions into a more explanatory mode, lowering her pitch slightly while maintaining a rapid tempo to describe the technical requirements of post-laser treatment skin care. (4) Another UI-style 'click' sound effect occurs as new text overlays appear. The vocal delivery remains dense and continuous, with very few pauses. The music stays at a consistent volume underneath the narration, never masking the primary signal. (5) As the video nears its conclusion, the female voice increases in intensity and arousal, emphasizing the lack of room for negotiation regarding medical advice. The music begins to fade out gradually as she finishes her final sentence. (6) The audio track concludes with the final notes of the background music fading into silence, while the speaker's voice stops completely, matching the appearance of the clinic's contact information card.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Explanation -> Solution -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional medical advisory and promotional piece for an acne scar treatment clinic. Dr. Chuang uses a stern but caring 'fierce doctor' persona to capture attention and emphasize the critical importance of post-operative care (using hydrocolloid dressings for 7 days) following an Ultra Pulse laser procedure to prevent post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the clinic's logo, the doctor identifying her clinic, specific medical services, and detailed contact information at the end.
